slides.sub: Kalapurusha — the cosmic man classical Jyotish maps onto all twelve signs.

slides.h2: Aries to Virgo: head to gut
Libra to Pisces: the lower half
It's not your Sun sign that matters
slides.body: Look at which planet is afflicted and which house it rules. That planet's Kalapurusha zone is the one under strain — not simply your Moon or Lagna sign.

Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra treats this as one diagnostic layer among several — alongside dasha, transit and Ayurvedic dosha — never definitive alone. Two charts with the same affliction can still manifest completely differently.
Jyotish is not diagnosis or treatment. It describes tendency, not certainty — for any health concern, please see a qualified doctor.
Comment your Moon sign and I'll tell you its Kalapurusha zone.
